digest.component_or_area: code-review gate model-class wiring / LLM runner
propositions: The code-review gate declares a model class on all five LLM-calling steps but every declaration is silently ignored at runtime, so every pass runs on the single resolved cfg.model.

The root cause is that PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config and resolves the model from the config it was constructed with (cfg = self._config), so the per-step model computed into req.config.model is never consulted.

The usage log records only op (prompt name) and cannot attribute a call to a step, since code-review-base is used by both the base step and the round_a/round_b batch finder; Step 0 adds step id and declared model_class to each record.
The fix substitutes req.config.model into a copy of the runner's config via _effective_config, matching the existing floor/override contract already used for temperature and usage limits.

The same runner defect broke four plan-review per-call model choices (verifier sub-calls and the prerequisite size-escalation ladder), so verifier configs and ladder escalation never took effect and the ladder's provenance record was untrue.

A recording-runner offline test asserting each of the five steps receives its declared class must sit beneath RunnerAgentStep's resolution, and live before/after probes under a discriminating class table confirm declarations move from all-cfg.model to honoured.
